benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly states for construction of a pucca house.
exclusions: Families already owning a pucca house
application_steps: Visit your Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office.
Verify your household details under the SECC housing deprivation list.
Submit required documents and bank details for geo-tagged house sanction.
